#include <unordered_map>
using namespace std;
typedef long long lol;
lol a[20];
unordered_map<lol, lol> memo;

lol solve(lol n) {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    if (memo.count(n)) return memo[n];
    int ind = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) {
        if (a[i] > n) {
            ind = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    lol ans1 = n / a[ind-1] * (ind-1) + solve(n % a[ind-1]);
    lol ans2 = 1e18;
    if (a[ind] - n < n) {
        ans2 = ind + solve(a[ind] - n);
    }
    return memo[n] = min(ans1, ans2);
}

int main() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        a[i] = a[i-1] * 10ll + 1ll;
    lol n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n) << endl;
    return 0;
